_doc: The swarm protocol registry (docs/swarm_api.md). One entry per range-map protocol, in picker order. reported: a bee may send it in ranges, listen_s and frames. aircraft: part of the `aircraft` union. stats: its legacy stats columns (Sample); a reported protocol without them sends `frames`. The device's tables (firmware/common/swarm/swarm_protocols.hh, swarm_recorder.hh) must match: a host test there checks name, unit_m, basis, aircraft, floors_ft, top_ft and stats of the reported entries, in order. Keep each entry a flat object.
